limitations_and_boundaries: FNO is extremely sensitive to noise, failing even with 0.1% Gaussian noise.
FNO originally cannot handle complex geometries or different input-output dimensions without extensions.
DeepONet and FNO may yield sub-optimal results for multiscale and non-smooth solutions without extensions.
Training neural operators can be expensive, though both can break curse of dimensionality.
Exponential convergence of DeepONet error with training data size switches to algebraic for large data due to finite network size.

methods.name: DeepONet
methods.protocol_description: DeepONet consists of branch and trunk networks. Extensions include POD-DeepONet (using POD modes as trunk), feature expansion (extra inputs to trunk), hard constraints for boundary conditions, and fast implementation.

methods.name: FNO
methods.protocol_description: Fourier Neural Operator parameterizes integral kernel in Fourier space. Extensions: dFNO+ (different input-output domains), gFNO+ (complex geometry), feature expansion.
